@IntegrationInACVF.Section5.OrderedContractionProgram.naturalMap_coordinate_difference : ∀ {M : Type}
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [inst : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {n m l : ℕ} {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet S n m}
  {U : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet S 0 l} (T : IntegrationInACVF.Section5.OrderedContractionProgram S A U)
  (a b : ↑A.carrier) (i : Fin n),
  (↑(T.naturalMap.toFun a)).2 = (↑(T.naturalMap.toFun b)).2 →
    (∀ (j : Fin n),
        j ≠ i →
          SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt (↑(T.naturalMap.toFun a)) j =
            SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt (↑(T.naturalMap.toFun b)) j) →
      SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt (↑a) i - SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt (↑b) i =

@IntegrationInACVF.Section5.MatchedUnaryPreparation.mk : {M : Type} →
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] →
    [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] →
      {G : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} →
        {m l : ℕ} →
          {A : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Point 1 m)} →
            {B : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Point 1 l)} →
              {e : ↑A ≃ ↑B} →
                (codes : Set M) →
                  G.real ⊆ codes →
                    (sourceA : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet codes 1 m) →
                      (sourceB : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet codes 1 l) →
                        (sourceA_eq : SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier sourceA = A) →
                          SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier sourceB = B →
                            (map : SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map sourceA sourceB) →
                              (∀ (a : ↑sourceA.carrier), ↑(map.toFun a) = ↑(e ⟨↑a, ⋯⟩)) →
                                Function.Bijective map.toFun →
                                  (arityA arityB : ℕ) →
                                    (targetA : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet codes 1 arityA) →
                                      (targetB : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet codes 1 arityB) →
                                        (specialA : SpecialTransformations.Section5.SpecialBijection sourceA targetA) →
                                          (specialB :
                                              SpecialTransformations.Section5.SpecialBijection sourceB targetB) →
                                            SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaChainDefinable G specialA.chain →
                                              SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaChainDefinable G specialB.chain →
                                                SpecialTransformations.Section5.IsRVPullback
                                                    (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier targetA) →
                                                  SpecialTransformations.Section5.IsRVPullback
                                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier targetB) →
                                                    SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaGraphDefinable G
                                                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointMapGraph
                                                          (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.unaryConjugate specialA specialB
                                                            map)) →
                                                      (iso :
                                                          SpecialTransformations.Section5.pullbackObject targetA ≅
                                                            SpecialTransformations.Section5.pullbackObject targetB) →
                                                        (∀ (a : ↑targetA.carrier),
                                                            (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.unaryIsoHomMap iso).toFun
                                                                ((SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map.toImage
                                                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.rawKeyMap
                                                                        targetA)).toFun
                                                                  a) =
                                                              (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map.toImage
                                                                    (SpecialTransformations.Section5.rawKeyMap
                                                                      targetB)).toFun
                                                                ((IntegrationInACVF.Section5.unaryConjugate specialA
                                                                      specialB map).toFun
                                                                  a)) →
                                                          SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaGraphDefinable G
                                                              (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.rvPullbackMapGraph
                                                                (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.unaryIsoHomMap iso)) →
                                                            SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaGraphDefinable G
                                                                (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.rvPullbackMapGraph
                                                                  (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.unaryIsoInvMap iso)) →
                                                              IntegrationInACVF.Section5.MatchedUnaryPreparation A B e

                      SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier source = A →

                                        {q |
                                          q ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier target ∧ q.2 ∘ Fin.natAdd 1 ∈ E} →

@IntegrationInACVF.Section5.padded_unary_branch_extension : ∀ {M : Type}
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {G : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {S : Set M} {a b l : ℕ}

      SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaSetDefinable G (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier H) →

          SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier D =
              {p | p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier H ∧ p.2 ∘ ρ ∈ E} →
            ∀ (P : IntegrationInACVF.Section5.RVProjectionPadding D A ρ),
              (∀ p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A,
                  ∀ q ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A,
                    p.2 = q.2 →
                      SpecialTransformations.Section5.rv (SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt p 0) =

@IntegrationInACVF.Section5.PaddedUnaryBranchLift.mk : {M : Type} →
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] →
    [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] →

                {u : SpecialTransformations.Section5.SpecialBijection A B} →
                  {H : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet S 1 l} →
                    {ρ : Fin a → Fin l} →
                      {E : Set (Fin a → SpecialTransformations.Section5.RV)} →
                        {previous : Option Bool} →
                          (arity : ℕ) →
                            (target : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet S 1 arity) →
                              (map : SpecialTransformations.Section5.Map H target) →
                                (projection : Fin b → Fin arity) →
                                  (arity_le : l ≤ arity) →
                                    IntegrationInACVF.Section5.SpecialRelativeBoundary map 0 previous
                                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain.lastKind previous u.chain) →
                                      SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaGraphDefinable G
                                          (SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointMapGraph map) →
                                        SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaSetDefinable G
                                            (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier target) →
                                          (∀ (j : Fin a),
                                              projection (IntegrationInACVF.Section5.suffixIndex ⋯ j) =
                                                IntegrationInACVF.Section5.suffixIndex arity_le (ρ j)) →
                                            (active_image : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet S 1 arity) →
                                              SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier active_image =
                                                  {q | ∃ p, (↑p).2 ∘ ρ ∈ E ∧ ↑(map.toFun p) = q} →
                                                IntegrationInACVF.Section5.RVProjectionPadding active_image B
                                                    projection →
                                                  SpecialTransformations.Section5.HeadSaturated
                                                      (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier active_image) →
                                                    SpecialTransformations.Section5.GammaSetDefinable G
                                                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier active_image) →
                                                      (∀ (p : ↑H.carrier),
                                                          (↑p).2 ∘ ρ ∉ E →
                                                            SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt (↑(map.toFun p)) 0 =
                                                              SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt (↑p) 0) →
                                                        (∀ (p q : ↑H.carrier),
                                                            (↑p).2 ∘ ρ ∉ E →
                                                              (↑q).2 ∘ ρ ∉ E →
                                                                SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV ↑p ↑q →
                                                                  SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV ↑(map.toFun p)
                                                                    ↑(map.toFun q)) →
                                                          (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Chain.lastKind previous
                                                                  u.chain ≠
                                                                Option.some Bool.true →
                                                              ∃ kH,
                                                                SpecialTransformations.Section5.Tagged
                                                                  (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier target) 0
                                                                  kH) →
                                                            IntegrationInACVF.Section5.PaddedUnaryBranchLift u H ρ E
                                                              previous

@IntegrationInACVF.Section5.FibreFocusData.mk : {M : Type} →
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] →
    [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] →
      {S : Set M} →
        {n m : ℕ} →
          {A : SpecialTransformations.Section5.DefSet S n m} →
            {i : Fin n} →
              {k : Fin m} →
                SpecialTransformations.Section5.Tagged (SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A) i k →
                  (locus : Set (SpecialTransformations.Section5.Point n m)) →
                    SpecialTransformations.Section5.SetDefinable (SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n m) S
                        locus →
                      (center : SpecialTransformations.Section5.Point n m → SpecialTransformations.Section5.VF) →
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section5.RelationDefinable
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section5.pointSpace n m) (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfSpace 1)
                            S fun p z => p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A ∩ locus ∧ z 0 = center p) →
                          (∀ p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A ∩ locus,
                              ∀ q ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A ∩ locus,
                                SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase i p = SpecialTransformations.Section5.erase i q →
                                  center p = center q) →
                            (∀ p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A ∩ locus,
                                SpecialTransformations.Section5.rv (center p) =
                                  SpecialTransformations.Section5.rv (SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt p i)) →
                              (∀ p ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A,
                                  ∀ q ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section5.carrier A,
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section5.SameRV p q →
                                      (∀ (j : Fin n),
                                          j ≠ i →
                                            SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt p j =
                                              SpecialTransformations.Section5.vfAt q j) →
                                        (p ∈ locus ↔ q ∈ locus)) →
                                IntegrationInACVF.Section5.FibreFocusData A i k
